scope: First three-platform run of the disposable native storage diagnostic (JSON-array byte transport, 15 checks). Linux and macOS executed it; Windows failed in an earlier authority step, so no Windows storage result exists for this run.

jobs.name: Native editor smoke (windows-latest)
skippedSteps: Test and audit disposable native storage diagnostic

windows.executedBeforeFailure: authority Rust unit tests passed (2); nine of ten authority checks and the denied WebView were recorded
windows.diagnosis: The ninth check passed and the remote fixture was served. The collector then waited 30 s inside a script that was pending while the WebView navigated to the remote document, and WebDriver reported a script timeout. The same step had passed on Windows in run 42397826185, so this is a timing-dependent collector weakness exposed on the hosted runner, not a changed authorization result. WebView2 losing the callback of a script pending across a document replacement is the working explanation and is not independently proven.
windows.notExecuted: The storage Rust tests, strict Clippy, dependency audit, storage build and storage diagnostic come after the failed step and did not run on Windows. Skipped steps are not passing steps.
windows.correction: Commit 463ea7d2df sets a 5 s script timeout and retries only that exact timeout, bounded and recorded, while still requiring the page evidence. Whether it resolves Windows is established only by a later run.

observations: Linux and macOS: 15/15 storage checks, empty CSP violations, a real reload with navigationType reload, an advanced generation and stale tickets denied.
macOS passed the authority, protocol, editor and embedded stages in the same run.
The first document lived 179 ms on Linux and 582 ms on macOS before the reload, which confirms why polling cannot be required to observe it.
limitations: This run predates raw binary IPC; later results supersede its transport but not its Windows failure.
No Windows storage result. Native storage on Windows (SQLite, automation profile directory, ACLs) is untested.
Compatibility evidence for a disposable fixture only.
